title: Yummy Irish Pistachio Casserole
description: A hearty, mustardy casserole with a glassy pistachio topping that brings Irish comfort to any table.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350F and grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, then add milk and cream and bring to a simmer.
Stir in Dijon mustard, honey, and strawberry jam until the mixture is smooth and glossy.
Whisk the eggs and pour them into the sauce, stirring constantly until fully incorporated.
Fold in the shredded potatoes, ground pistachios, salt, pepper, and cheddar cheese until everything is evenly coated.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish and spread it out evenly.
Bake for 30 minutes until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before cutting into squares.
